title: A parts import row with no part number is skipped with no message
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete', See Financial Data and the Data Import setting.
  • {Bin-A} (for example General Storage) is a bin location of {Location-A}.
  • No part or Part Library entry has the description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL NO NUMBER ROW).
  • No part or Part Library entry has the number {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SKIP-02) in any upper and lower case or punctuation.
  • Import file {File-A} (for example ZZ-PL-SKIP.csv) holds two rows. The first has an empty part number and the description {Description-A}. The second has the part number {Part-A} and the description {Description-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL SKIP CONTROL).
  • Both rows have quantity 1 and Bin Location {Bin-A}.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings → Data Import → Inventory.
  2. Upload {File-A}.
  3. Run the import.
  4. Go to Parts → Inventory and type {Description-A} in the search.
  5. Click the Inactive tab.
  6. Go to Parts → Part Library and type {Description-A} in the search.
  7. Go to Parts → Inventory, click the Active tab and type {Part-A} in the search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: the import finishes. No error or warning message about the row with no part number appears.
  • Step 4: no row: the row with no part number was skipped.
  • Step 5: no row on the Inactive tab either.
  • Step 6: no entry has the description {Description-A}.
  • Step 7: one row, {Part-A} with {Description-B}: the other row of the same file was imported.
